title: An evaluator's one submission can be lost by citing a non-holder note it was able to read
outcome: An evaluator knows from its brief which records it may cite, so one invalid citation doesn't cost a whole judgment.
acceptance: The evaluator's brief states or marks which records are citable as run evidence, so a non-holder or pre-claim observation isn't offered as one, with a behaviour test on what the brief carries; Engram's refusal of a bad citation stays as it is.
A review pair has no Medium or higher, and the normal gate passes.
disposal_reason: No host defect shown. Engram::Fable (mailbox ebe242f7 #7231): attempt 2's brief already marks such records '[context only: the tracker refuses this as a citation]', including 8a21ffb1. The running build db52491e carries that mark at src/acceptance_evaluation.rs:1322, so attempt 1's brief very likely had it too, though nobody has read that brief. An evaluator citing a marked record is model behaviour, and Engram's refusal plus the reuse route worked. Reopen with a new item if a brief is found that offers such a record unmarked.
